SELECT object_id, storage_path, created_at
FROM archive_objects
WHERE retention_days > 45
  AND deletion_marked = false
  AND legal_hold = false
ORDER BY created_at ASC, object_id ASC
LIMIT 240;

-- Cleanup runs after the daily inventory transaction.
-- Preserve objects with an active legal hold.
-- Record the selected object identifiers before deletion.
-- Retry transient storage failures in the next scheduled run.

projects.source:
Blob recovery procedure

Step 1: Pause the recovery worker before inspecting the manifest.
Step 2: Set the retry interval to 18 seconds.
Step 3: Read the newest committed manifest from the control bucket.
Step 4: Compare each object checksum with its manifest entry.
Step 5: Restore missing objects into the staging namespace.
Step 6: Verify the restored object count before enabling reads.
Step 7: Resume the recovery worker and observe the error counter.
Step 8: Record the manifest identifier in the incident log.
